book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Diyon wana Leleli

content: Yeisu I Ba, “Nau Oine Puna”
“Nau oine hot puna, ge Nam iya toeyowa.
Lala bolo hi siuna eliyau ge nige hi eenon, gegewel ni gotomwa yohil, yaa lala gegewel bolo hi enon ni abubunil, laliya bolo hi nak ni tomwa yohil, inoke nihi enon nabi.
Komiu iyaka ku waisi kaiwena baaba bolo ya baunan eliyamiu iyaka i abubunimiu.
Nuku minaa eliyau, inoke nau na minaa eliyamiu. Nige bosowaina lala etega totona ni enon ebo nige ni miminaa puna elana. I ola al komiu nige bosowaina nuku enon ebo nige nuku miminaa eliyau.
“Nau oine puna ge komiu lalana. Henala ebo ni minaa elau, ge nau na minaa elana, iya ni enon nabi. Yaa ebo nuku miluwagau, nige bosowaina bugul etega nuku ginol.
Henala ebo nige ni miminaa elau, iya i ola lala toto hi aliyoho ge i yakiwa. Lala ololana o hi bugul papahe inoke hi yoho tukan ginahaa ge nihi kalas.
Ebo nuku minaa elau ge no baaba ni minaa eliyamiu, bugul bolo nuwamiu nuku awanun kaiweliya, inoke nuku pwawa.
Ebo nuku enon nabi ge nuku ola no tohago, he toto ya Nam ni pawasawasa.
“Nau ya nunuwana-agimiu, i ola ya te Nam i nunuwana-agau. He nuku minaa no nunuwana gamwanaa.
Ebo no logugui nuku henapuan, inoke nuku minaa no nunuwana gamwanaa, ni ola nau Nam wana logugui ya henapuan ge ya minaa wana nunuwana gamwanaa.
Baaba ya ya baunan eliyamiu inoke no yaliyaya ni mina eliyamiu ge wami yaliyaya ni pakalaopop.
He no logugui iya hiwe: nuku penununuwana alomiyau elal ni ola nau ya nunuwana-agimiu.
Nige gamagal etega wana nunuwana ana bwata ni oola toto yawalina i talamwan wana heliyamwau kaiweliya.
Ebo nuku ginol ni ola no logugui, he komiu no heliyamwau.

Nige al na aawa totuwalali-agimiu, kaiwena totuwalali nige i aatena te wana tonowak hauna i giginol. Yaa nau ya awa heliyamwau-agimiu, kaiwena bugul gegewena bolo ya hagoem Nam elana iyaka ya pamasal eliyamiu.
Komiu nige ku hihileyau, yaa nau ya hilemiu nuku nok nuku na nuku enon, ge enomiu o ni mihot. Inoke hauna gun ebo nuku awanuni alau elana, Nam ni pewa.
He no logugui iya hiwe: nuku penununuwana-agimiu.”
Gamagalau abwe Tohago Nihi Pihigelgel-agil
Yeisu i ba, “Ebo panayawi gamagaliliyau nihi pihigelgel-agimiu, nuku nuwahikan te hi pihigelgel-agau houwan.

Binimala ebo nuku minek panayawi gamagaliliyau ali boda elana, inoke nihi nunuwana-agimiu ni ola komiu avaliyau. Yaa komiu nige ku miminek ali boda elana, nau ya hilemiwa gamwaliyaa. Inoke heiya te kaiwena panayawi gamagaliliyau hi pihigelgel-agimiu.

Baaba toto ya baunan eliyamiu nuku nuwahikan i ola hiwe: ‘Totuwalali nige wana babala i bwabwata lake.’ Ebo hi palopalomwan-agau, he komiu al ge nihi palopalomwan-agimiu. Ebo no baaba hi henapuan, he komiu al ge wami baaba nihi henapuan.
Nau kaiweu pagan ya nihi ginol eliyamiu, kaiwena toto i patunau nige hi aatena.
Binimala nige na nenem ge wali wasa na pepek, he nige ali woliwoli ni gagan wali gegi kaiwena. Yaa sauga ya nige wali epaepakuna i gagan wali gegi kaiwena.
Toto ebo i pihigelgel-agau, he i pihigelgel al Nam elana.

Ginol ololal nige sauga etega gamagal etega i giginol, nau ya ginol gamwaliyaa. Binimala nigeya, inoke nige ali woliwoli ni gagan wali gegi kaiwena. He ginol yawiyawi ya ginolil iyaka hi kite, yaa bwagana o, alou ge Nam hi pihigelgel-agima.
I masal i ola to inoke baaba toto wali Logugui ana buki gamwanaa i patunahot, toto i ba, ‘Hi pihigelgel-agau bwabwage nige wali puna i gagan.’
“Abwe Tolabe ni nem, iya Yayaluwa toto Yehoba ana aatena tutunahotina ana topamasal ge i tagilem Nam elana. Iya na patuna eliyamiu ni neem Nam elana ge wasau ni wasaan.
Yaa komiu al ge wasau nuku wasaan, kaiwena i telipunaa sauga toto tuwalali ya telipuna, alowau komiu ya.
